channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Rising global oil prices offer fiscal lifeline to 3 sub-Saharan producers amid Iran tensions
item.description: Rising geopolitical tensions involving Iran have pushed global oil prices sharply higher, creating potential economic gains for a small group of African oil exporters.

item.title: Ghana signs debt restructuring deal with Belgium after 2022 default
item.description: Ghana has signed a bilateral debt restructuring agreement with Belgium as the West African country continues efforts to rebuild its finances after a deep economic crisis forced it to default on its debt in 2022.

item.title: Middle East crisis pushes oil prices higher, threatening several African economies
item.description: The escalating conflict in the Middle East is raising economic risks for many African countries as rising oil prices threaten to weaken currencies, worsen trade balances and push inflation higher across the continent.

item.title: China and the US pressure Ghana to pause new gold royalty hike
item.description: Mining companies have warned that the upper end of Ghana’s proposed new royalty regime could make the country one of the most expensive mining jurisdictions in Africa.

item.title: World’s biggest container carrier MSC imposes war surcharge of up to $4000 per container on shipments to Africa
item.description: World's largest container shipping firm, Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC) announced that it will introduce a “war surcharge” for cargo shipments to African nations and Indian Ocean islands from the Indian subcontinent and Gulf countries.

item.title: Egypt distances itself from Russian LNG tanker that sank in the Mediterranean
item.description: Egypt’s petroleum ministry denied any connection to a Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) tanker that sank in the Mediterranean on Wednesday.

item.title: Dangote promises to shield Nigerians from war-driven energy inflation
item.description: The Dangote Petroleum Refinery has promised to shield Nigeria from the conflict-driven energy inflation currently affecting some parts of the globe, in the face of a slight fuel increase.

item.title: Dangote builds 1,100km gas pipeline and plans deep-sea port at Olokola
item.description: Africa’s richest man, Aliko Dangote, is quietly developing a massive gas transportation network that could help solve one of Nigeria’s biggest energy challenges, moving gas reliably from the Niger Delta to industries and export hubs.

item.title: Union Dicon Salt urges Brazil’s Aims Limited to contact company amid revival effort
item.description: A Nigerian salt producer listed on the Nigerian Exchange (NGX) has issued an unusual public appeal asking its largest shareholder to contact the company after repeated attempts to reach the investor failed.

item.title: Africa’s fastest-growing travel destination earns $161 million from foreign visitors in 90 days
item.description: Rwanda generated about $161.5 million in revenue from travel services purchased by foreign visitors between November 2025 and January 2026, according to new figures released by the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda.
